thread:
deploy-bot: Canary failed in eu-west1 for release v2.17.3-hotfix — 4/10 errors on inference nodes. Rollout halted. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/889 :warning:

maria.chen: Seeing the same in staging logs this morning. Errors look like OOMs during large-batch inference.

ben_k: Can we pin to v2.17.2 on eu-west1 and rerun canary? Need expedited approval to avoid impact on live customers.

release-manager: @channel we need a 2-person rapid-approval for an emergency pin + hotfix deploy. Who can +1? :eyes:

emma: +1 for pin to v2.17.2 in eu-west1 only. Will prepare release note blurb.

davew: +1. Also suggest increasing autoscale headroom temporarily (scale buffer to 30%) and enable small-batch mode for the canary.

sre-oncall: Agreed. I'll execute the pin and autoscale tweak once approvals are recorded. Command I'll run:
```
/deploy pin --region eu-west1 --version v2.17.2 --scope canary
/infra scale --region eu-west1 --buffer 30
/feature toggle --service inference --flag small-batch true --duration 30m
```

maria.chen: Adding quick test plan: run 50 synthetic requests with 2k token prompts after pin, watch 95th pct latency and KVCACHE hit rate. If errors < 1% and 95th pct < 350ms we proceed full rollout.

ben_k: TL;DR approvals: emma +1, davew +1, release-manager can sign off after SRE confirms post-pin smoke.

sre-oncall: Running pin now. Will report status in ~3m.

deploy-bot: Action queued: /deploy pin --region eu-west1 --version v2.17.2 --scope canary — requested by sre-oncall (exec). Token: deploy-req-889.

sre-oncall: Pin applied. Autoscale buffer increased. Small-batch flag enabled. Kickoff synthetic tests.

deploy-bot: Synthetic smoke started (50 reqs). Check logs: https://logs.redwood/tx/889-canary-eu

maria.chen: First 10 tests passed, one timeout at request 12 (retriable). Continuing.

emma: Draft release note: "Hotfix: revert recent quantization change impacting large-batch inference in eu-west1; pinned to v2.17.2. Monitoring active." Will paste full note after SRE green.

sre-oncall: Smoke complete: 50/50 success, 95th pct 320ms, errors 0%. Recommend roll to 20% traffic, then monitor for 15m before full rollout.

release-manager: Official sign-off: proceeding with 20% canary rollout. Notifying support + customer success. I'll update release notes and tag the PR. :white_check_mark:

ben_k: Thanks team. After 15m and no regression, schedule full rollout and cleanup the small-batch flag.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic shift scheduled: 0% -> 20% at 7532109990. Will post updates.

sre-oncall: Leaving a note for postmortem: confirm root cause of OOM in v2.17.3 quant path and ensure CI includes large-batch stress tests.

maria.chen: Agreed. I'll own the postmortem with research/ML next week.

release-manager: Closing thread once full rollout done. Thanks everyone. :pray:
